empty_reason.description: Present when entries is empty. Explains entry delivery, not risk; diffs may still be present. Unchanged entries require the prior receipt.

impact.description: Full-analysis verdict before packet trimming. Incomplete means an analysis or admission limitation; budget omissions never change it. Potential impact is not a defect or severity verdict.

complete.description: False if analysis or delivered packet coverage is incomplete.

budget_omitted.description: Entries and diffs omitted by packing, independent of impact.

budget_omitted_entries.description: Code entry candidates omitted for budget, excluding provided-diff spans and unchanged delta entries.

budget_omitted_diffs.description: Raw diff candidates omitted for budget, excluding provided-diff spans; may be nonzero for unsupported source languages.

provided_diff.description: Fully covered candidates excluded on the caller's declaration that their text is already in the diff. Does not prove review coverage.

overlapping_entries.description: Eligible entries partially overlapping supplied ranges; fully covered exclusions are counted in entries.

selected_outside_entries.description: Canonical selected entries with no overlap against supplied ranges, including unchanged delta entries.

selected_overlapping_entries.description: Canonical selected entries partially overlapping supplied ranges, including unchanged delta entries. Counts whole entries, not duplicated tokens.

metadata_tokens.description: Measured preselection envelope tokens with empty entries/diffs and a zero placeholder for this count. Later selection and delta controls use a separate reserve; not a final wire token decomposition.

first_entry_tokens.description: Packing cost of the first code candidate before optional history, including its ID/control allowance. No guarantee it fits the remaining budget.
